summary: Iteration 69 — Test Template sandbox + Push-to-One-Template + Push-to-One-Tenant + PagesBar verified end-to-end. Ran 13 pytest cases (all 13 passed) covering: GET /api/test-template shape (key=test_template, brand=Test Template, is_rollout_admin=true, 32 sibling templates each with pending flag) and GET /api/public/templates returning 33 including test_template; GET /api/test-template/diff scope counts (all=32, classic=16, studio=16, selected=1, selected+empty=400) with rows correctly grouped into Design/Animations/Features and each carrying old/new/kind/tenants/variance; POST /api/test-template/rollout error paths (wrong confirm → 400, invalid change ids → 400, non-admin client.editor@example.com → 403); valid selected-scope push updates ONLY the picked template (verified isolation against another template via /api/public/templates), persists to template_looks, flips template_states.status='pending' for that key, and writes a rollout_jobs entry with kind='template_look' that appears in /api/test-lab/rollout/history with can_undo=true; PERSISTENCE: after `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, load_overrides re-applies the pushed value (checked via /api/public/templates/{key}); UNDO: POST /api/test-lab/rollout/jobs/{id}/undo with CONFIRM restores the previous value in template_looks + LOOKS and flips can_undo=false with undone_at set; PUSH-TO-ONE-TENANT: seeded a random primary on Test Lab, POST /api/test-lab/rollout with target_app_ids=['app_03efdf8b1af4'] + changes=['design.primary'] creates a kind='single' job that only touches that tenant — verified every other tenant's primary is byte-identical before/after; /api/test-lab/pending returns per-tenant counts summing to total; Test Lab archive/delete still 400. Playwright pass: (1) client-mode /choose/<token> shows 32 cards, no test_template, no yellow badge; (2) Dashboard admin view has Test Lab pinned first with GREEN tenant-test-badge-app_testlab, ORANGE tenant-pending-badge-app_03efdf8b1af4, and both push-to-all-tenants-card-btn + push-to-one-tenant-btn; (3) /apps/app_testlab → SITE MODE renders data-testid='pages-bar' with 33 page-tab-* + 33 page-tag-* cards, scrollWidth (7230) >> clientWidth confirms horizontal scrolling; clicking three different cards yields three distinct brand-coloured backgrounds at 85% opacity (rgba(249,115,22,0.85) hospitality orange, rgba(250,204,21,0.85) yellow, rgba(201,162,78,0.85) gold), proving the selected fill follows the page's own theme_preview.primary. No blocking console errors (two benign 401s from an unauthenticated pre-login fetch).
critical_code_review_comments: test_template.py _resolve_targets raises 400 with 'Choose at least one template to push to' both when the caller sends scope=selected+empty AND when they send an unknown key — the two cases are indistinguishable to the client. Consider returning 404 (or a distinct message) when the requested key doesn't exist in LOOKS.

test_template.py POST /test-template/rollout stores a rollout_snapshots doc keyed by template_key + before_look but never adds a compound index; the collection already grows unbounded per iter67/68 feedback. A TTL on rollout_snapshots OR retaining only the latest per template_key would keep it bounded.

test_lab.py _run_undo template branch double-increments `done` (lines 506 + 531) when a snapshot has template_key — undo_pct still lands at 100 because of the explicit final $set, but the intermediate progress reported to /rollout/jobs/{id} briefly overshoots. Minor cosmetic.

test_lab.py POST /test-lab/rollout accepts target_app_ids but does NOT reject the case where all provided ids are invalid or archived (they just get filtered by _targets(only) to zero); the job silently runs with 0 targets and status=done. Consider a 400 if the intersection is empty.

templates_gallery.py /public/templates emits the test_template row unfiltered; client-mode hiding is only enforced in the React layer (TemplateGallery.jsx line 169). Anyone hitting the API directly with a share token would still see it. Consider filtering server-side when the request carries a share token.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required data-testids present, selected-card brand colour swaps correctly, scrollbar active)

seed_data_creation: Created one template-share token via POST /template-shares to exercise /choose/<token>. Mutated Test Lab tenant primary colour (via PUT /apps/app_testlab/theme) to seed a push-to-one-tenant diff; app_03efdf8b1af4 primary was left at the pushed value (random hex chosen per run). Pushed one Design field from test_template to the 'legal' template, verified persistence across restart, then undid the push — so template_looks.legal is back to the pre-push value. No tenants/pages/leads/users were created or deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tenants unchanged: app_testlab (protected) and app_03efdf8b1af4 (safe rollout target — its `theme.primary` now holds whatever random hex the last iter69 push-to-one-tenant test wrote; if you need a known-diff seed use PUT /apps/app_testlab/theme). PUSH_KEY='legal' was used for the template push/undo cycle; that template's look is back to baseline. pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope` — this new test file MUST be run with `-n 0` because all 13 tests share sequential state on Test Lab + one target tenant. The test file auto-restarts the backend once (test_persistence_across_backend_restart) — takes ~15s.
rca of the issue: No functional regressions. Two scripting notes: (1) initial pytest run failed because os.environ['REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL'] isn't propagated into the backend virtualenv — the test file now falls back to parsing /app/frontend/.env. (2) The push-to-one-tenant test initially skipped on re-runs because the previous run had already pushed the same hard-coded primary '#123abc' — switched to a random hex per run so the diff is always non-empty.
